title: Self-Refining Prompt Induction for Streaming Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2611.00960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-SQL assistants for streaming engines must handle dialect-specific types, windowing rules, and temporal semantics, including constructs poorly handled by generic prompts. We present Self-Refining Prompt Induction (SRPI), an offline method that converts generation failures into reusable dialect instructions while keeping model weights fixed. A Refiner revises the Generator's prompt using reference-conditioned feedback from three LLM judges; a sampled regression guard checks earlier successes, and a separate Compressor reduces prompt length. Inference uses the frozen prompt without retrieval or query repair. We evaluate cross-domain and cross-model transfer on Confluent Cloud Flink SQL using a controlled synthetic workload seeded by 30 expert-written examples, with 335 induction examples and 257 questions from held-out domains. The same induced prompt improves mean judge scores across seven Generators by 7.1-19.2 percentage points,

translated_title: 面向流式Text-to-SQL的自精炼提示归纳
translated_abstract: 面向流式引擎的Text-to-SQL助手必须处理方言特定的数据类型、窗口规则和时间语义，包括那些通用提示难以处理的构造。我们提出了自精炼提示归纳（Self-Refining Prompt Induction, SRPI），这是一种离线方法，能够在保持模型权重不变的情况下，将生成失败转化为可复用的方言指令。一个精炼器使用来自三个LLM评判者的参考条件反馈来修改生成器的提示；采样的回归防护机制会检查先前的成功案例是否仍然有效，而一个单独的压缩器则用于缩短提示长度。推理阶段使用冻结的提示，无需检索或查询修复。我们在Confluent Cloud Flink SQL上评估了跨域和跨模型的迁移能力，实验使用由30个专家编写示例作为种子的受控合成工作负载，包含335个归纳示例和来自保留域的257个问题。同一个归纳出的提示使七个生成器的平均评判得分提高了7.1至19.2个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出自精炼提示归纳（SRPI）离线方法，利用三个LLM评判者的反馈迭代优化提示，将生成失败转化为可复用的流式SQL方言指令，在模型权重和提示均冻结的情况下，使七个生成器的平均得分提升7.1至19.2个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Self-Refining Prompt Induction (SRPI), an offline method that iteratively refines prompts via reference-conditioned feedback from three LLM judges to convert generation failures into reusable streaming SQL dialect instructions, improving mean judge scores across seven generators by 7.1-19.2 percentage points with frozen model weights and no retrieval at inference.
